name: Cursor Runtime
description: Run Cursor agents as an OpenClaw model runtime

apiKeyFile.description: File holding CURSOR_API_KEY; used when the env var is unset

force.description: Auto-approve native tool permission prompts (default true). Only the acp transport surfaces prompts; with false they are routed to OpenClaw approvals.

transport.description: sdk (default): Cursor SDK agents with OpenClaw tools; acp: persistent cursor-agent acp process; print: one cursor-agent -p per turn

acpModelAliases.description: Extra OpenClaw model id -> Cursor ACP model id mappings

useHttp1.description: Use HTTP/1.1 for Cursor SDK agent traffic (default true; needed behind HTTP proxies)

effort.description: Default Cursor effort for models without an effort suffix when /think is not set (default medium for claude-*)

modelDefaults.description: Defaults applied to Cursor model selections

agentIdleMinutes.description: sdk transport: close cached Cursor agents idle for this many minutes (default 360; 0 disables the sweep). They are reopened on the next turn.

finishOnFinalMessage.description: sdk transport: end the turn as soon as the agent delivers its answer with message(final:true), skipping the wrap-up model call that only returns NO_REPLY (default true)

autoCompactTokens.description: sdk transport: absolute context-token threshold for background compaction; overrides autoCompactPercent when set (0 or unset: use the percentage). /compact always works.

autoCompactPercent.description: sdk transport: compact a session in the background once one model call fills this percentage of the context window, as Claude Code does (default 90; 0 turns automatic compaction off)

persistState.description: sdk transport: keep recent agents, compaction state and tool definitions in a state file across gateway restarts (default true)

prewarm.description: sdk transport: reopen recently used Cursor agents after gateway start-up (default true)

prewarmDelaySeconds.description: sdk transport: seconds after start-up before the prewarm runs (default 180)
